verdict.rationale: Pipedream's core product is event-triggered workflows. App, HTTP/webhook, schedule, email and RSS triggers start pre-built actions or custom code, and a community user reports an automated Airtable-to-Algolia feed built with it. Rule logic is expressed through workflow steps and custom code. missing for 10: explicit documentation of declarative conditional/filter rules, deeper independent corroboration of complex rule chains.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Source-available triggers and actions for thousands of integrated apps
Triggers for apps like Twitter, GitHub, and more, HTTP / Webhook, Schedule, Email, RSS
